data.content_ref: inline:SRC_003's resource-atrophy mechanism predicts a progressive decline in rival lineage capacity, but it never specifies what to count within a single run to observe that atrophy, nor how to distinguish atrophy caused by ownership allocation from atrophy caused by global budget limits (its own counterexample 3). Without a per-run count of rival vocabulary maintenance or failed alternative explanations, the suppression-vs-efficiency distinction is untestable on SRC_003's account.
